beats.title: Coliseum Championship Begins
beats.summary: The Coliseum Championship starts with a meteor crashing into the arena, creating burning rock piles. Bonogo attacks the Storm Elemental, which splits into two forms; it retaliates with lightning against Ogonob and Bonogo. Ogonob teleports and attacks with force damage, while Baergrom uses action surge and warhammer strikes on the Stone Elemental, which misses its counterattack.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-11:a64c1f3075a0:span:a64c1f3075a0:14-14
anchor_quotes: The Coliseum Championship Suddenly the terrain changes: a huge meteor crashes down into the arena, splashing smaller pieces all over the ground.
Bonogo uses his short bow to attack the Storm Elemental.
Ogonob teleports behind the elemental then attacks using force damage.
Baergrom uses his action surge and swings his warhammer at the Stone Elemental 3 separate times, dealing a good amount of damage.

beats.title: Second Terrain Shift and Storm Elemental Defeated
beats.summary: Terrain changes again: a hole opens under Bonogo, who is burned but climbs up and attacks with short sword and whip. The Storm Elemental casts a spell on Bonogo, making him believe the ground is collapsing. Lightning hits both Bonogo and Ogonob; Ogonob teleports and decapitates the Storm Elemental. Baergrom misses with his hammer, disengages, and recovers it. The Stone Elemental slams Baergrom but fails to crush him. Lava erupts from the walls. Bonogo and Ogonob damage the remaining elemental, which is visibly losing cohesion. Baergrom attacks multiple times; the elemental swings wildly and hits Ogonob, then both wink out of existence.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-11:a64c1f3075a0:span:a64c1f3075a0:16-16
anchor_quotes: Again the ground changes, this time a large hole opens up under Bonogo and he is forced prone and burned.
Ogonob again teleports behind the elemental, then striking with a swift blow, removes the head of the Storm Elemental.
Baergrom takes the chance to swing his hammer again, only to miss completely and watch it fly out of his hands, landing somewhere off to his left.
The terrain of the arena changes again. Suddenly lava erupts out of the walls.
The Stone Elemental wildly swings its remaining arm and catches Ogonob for a devastating blow. They wink out of existence.

beats.title: Final Terrain Change and Victory
beats.summary: A magnetic field manifests near Bonogo and Baergrom; Bonogo is pulled in and damaged, but Baergrom withstands it. Bonogo destroys the elemental, and the crowd cheers, with Karsemine leading the chant. The group leaves the arena, learning results will be announced the next day. Bonogo looks for the hooded figure but sees an empty seat. Meanwhile, Caelynn goes to the Academy to find Professor Tealeaf, who encourages her to enroll and teaches her about a paralysis potion made from mushrooms. Caelynn learns the professor who left was obsessed with storms and plants, and left about 30 years ago.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-11:a64c1f3075a0:span:a64c1f3075a0:18-18
anchor_quotes: The terrain changes one last time. A huge magnetic field manifests near Bonogo and Baergrom.
Bonogo unleashes a series of devastating attacks on the elemental, snuffing out the magic and destroying it.
The crowd erupts in cheers and Karsemine leads the familiar Bonogo chant.
Bonogo takes one final look back to the stands where he saw the hooded figure, but the seat is empty.
Meanwhile, Caelynn heads back to the Stromspire Academy to find Professor Tealeaf.
She encourages Caelynn to enroll at the academy, then explains the potion she can make from her mushrooms: a potent paralysis potion that can also cause Fear.
He left about 30 years ago.

beats.title: Caelynn Sets Up Mushroom Garden and Tavern Celebration
beats.summary: Caelynn sets up a mushroom growing area in her room, then finds a furniture store called Spore and Timber. She trades mushrooms for herb boxes, sets them on her balcony, and goes to the inn. At the Copper and Quartz, Ephanna, Bonogo, and Baergrom rest, encounter Stafl, who gives a loud introduction, causing the crowd to go wild and drinks to be passed around.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-11:a64c1f3075a0:span:a64c1f3075a0:20-20
anchor_quotes: She heads back to the manor and sets up a small area in her room for the mushrooms to grow, then heads into the city to find a proper furniture store.
She finds the Spore and Timber, a store growing right out of a giant stump.
She sets them up on her balcony at the manor then heads for the Inn.
Back at the Copper and Quartz, Ephanna, Bonogo and Baergrom are looking for a short rest, when they encounter Stafl.
He has been "practicing" all day (drinking) and launches into a loud introduction of the fighters to the tavern crowd.
